mission.title: Nothing Ever Goes As Planned
mission.description: Find the Cypherites and patch up the Merovingian's deal with them.

npc.say: How about a taste of your own medicine?

phase.briefing:
I have some troubling news for you, {player}. We've decoded that data you found earlier and... let's just say that those masked fools can figure a thing out if you give them enough time. They ran further traces on the Union Hill box job. They may be onto our trail.
You need to go patch things up with them. Tell them whatever they need to hear! Just make sure the deal we have isn't broken.

enter.say: This is one of the Cypherite bases. That's funny... it seems pretty quiet in there.

done.say: Empty! I wonder why no one is here... you can leave now.

phase.briefing:
Quite frankly, it wasn't very polite of them to move without sending us a forwarding address! No matter, we have other contact locations.
Move along. We need to talk to them.

enter.say: It's looking pretty quiet in here, too... don't get your hopes up.

done.say: Is it just me, or is this turning into a wild goose chase? I think you can leave this building.

phase.briefing: Bah, I'm sure this is all a misunderstanding. Keep looking for them, {player}, and use the skills you possess... you have skills, right? Well, ah... just ask yourself, what would Flood do?

enter.say: Flood is such an ass... Okay, looks like the same drill. I don't know why we're keeping up this charade.
What the-- I'm reading signals all over the place, and I don't think they're in the mood for chatting! Time to knock some heads, {player}.

done.say: Nice body count, {player}! You can get out of there now.

mission.finish:
We received a message from Veil while you were fighting, {player}. Some unflattering comparisons were made. I... ah...
Well, above all, one thing is clear: Our little deal has been canceled. The Merovingian will not be pleased.
